values.note: 2026 rates: water & electric sites $50 a night (April to mid-May, September, October) and $60 (June-August); $315/$380 a week; monthly by arrangement. Holiday weekends $215 for three nights or $80 a night. Tent sites $40-47. The rate covers a family unit (parents and their unmarried children under 19 living at home) or two other people; anyone else in the camper pays the overnight guest fee, $12 at 15 and up, $9 at 4-15 (+$3 on holiday weekends). Without parents on the site everyone must be 21 and a site takes 4 at most. Early arrival or late departure $20. Read 2026-11-11.

values.note: Reservations by phone (860-564-4534 or 800-424-4534) or email; one night's deposit within 7 days, holiday weekends paid in full. Cancellation 14+ days out refunded less $25 a site; none after that, and none on holiday weekends. Check-in 3 p.m., check-out 2 p.m. No generators.

note: Family campground on Bailey Pond in Voluntown, pine-shaded and grassy sites, with a boat launch (10 hp max), boat rentals and a separate spring-fed swimming pond; seasonal sites as well as nightly and weekly stays. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: 2026 W/E $50 shoulder / $60 summer (price gate passes at $50, Providence gateway 38 km anyway), 30/50 amp, dump, store; extra-person guest fees recorded; RoverPass-derived pull-throughs, showers and laundry cleared (laundry removed from the operator page); phone booking.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: cheapest W/E night $50.00 (April-mid-May, Sept, Oct; $60 June-Aug), operator's 2026 rate table at campcirclec.com/index.php read 2026-11-11 - not over US$50; gateway Providence 38 km (gateways.py) in any case. Good Sam Park: no (stored good_sam false). Not stayed at by the family.

REVIEWS: Google Maps 'Circle 'C' Campground, Inc' 4.5 from 56 reviews (phone +1 860-564-4534, website campcirclec.com, pin 41.6391,-71.7945 = stored pin). RV Life 4.5 / $$ (stored). No site under 4.0.

LONG-STAY: operator posts nightly, weekly and holiday rates for tent and W/E sites (test 2 passes); 'Seasonal Sites: $3,300.00 + electric meter' and 'Monthly - check with office' also offered, plus spring/fall six-weekend 'Leave Camper on Site' specials. No online engine, so no occupancy check was possible (reservations by phone/email). Newest Google reviews read are from repeat summer visitors ('This is my third year coming to Circle C', 'We visited ... mid August of this year (2024)'); one 8-year-old review says 'We return here several times every season. Its our home away from home.' I do not read it as mostly seasonal: the operator leads with its nightly/weekly rate table.
PRESENCE: campcirclec.com answers 200 and is this park (21 Bailey Pond Rd, Voluntown; phones 860-564-4534 and 800-424-4534 match the stored phone).
SITES: stored count 118 (from a RoverPass listing) is roughly consistent with the operator's map (about 112 hook-up + 4 tent sites, map 'not drawn to scale'); left as stored, pull_through cleared.
Holiday-weekend rule: the policy says 'Holiday weekends: 3 night minimum stay', but the rate table also sells '$80.00/Night (if not 3 nights)', so no min_stay was written.
